title: Unleashing Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models via Textual Representation Guided Reasoning

layout.note: Two columns: the left holds panel (a) above panel (b), each a tinted rounded frame with its caption below; the tall panel (c) fills the right third. No arrows between panels: letters give the order and shared colours give the correspondence.

lesson: Carry one concrete scene through every panel and give each object a fixed colour that reappears in the human description, the map and the structured record, so the correspondence reads without arrows. End with the method as a prompt card whose slots keep those colours.
